title: Prospect-page tracking: delete the dead events, count submits on the server, add a viewer id
recommendation: Delete the four event types that no code emits, record form submits from the worker after the row is stored, and give each prospect a stored per-page viewer id so return visits fall out of page_view rows without a new event.

questions.q: Delete section_view, section_dwell, scroll_depth and return_visit rather than build them?
Privacy: store a per-page viewer id in the prospect's browser so return visits can be shown?
questions.recommended: Yes, as localStorage scoped to the share id with no cookie and no cross-page use. If William wants zero client storage on prospect pages, "returned" stays unbuilt and the answer to question 1 covers it.

questions.q: Count form submits on the server after the row is stored?
questions.recommended: Yes. The stored row is the truth; the event is for the stats timeline.
